_readme: WP7 known failures: engine-checkable worked examples that do not pass against the generated snapshots, with the triage category and the routed fix.

Both harnesses (api/test/card_worked_examples.test.js, packages/pandapay_domain/test/card_worked_examples_test.dart) assert that each listed example STILL fails in the listed engines, so a fix shows up as a failing test until its entry is removed. No example is skipped silently.
Keys are <source_slug>#<example id>. category: example_wrong | research_data | directory_data | loader_bug | engine_bug.

axis-bank-magnus#006.summary: 35 pts/Rs200 above Rs1.5 lakh a month needs base_150k_spend to carry post_cap_behavior custom_rate (35 per Rs200). The loader only emits base_rate/zero, so the accelerated band earns the base 12.

axis-bank-magnus#007.summary: Same as #006: spend after the Rs1.5 lakh line should earn 35 per Rs200 (custom post-cap rate).

flipkart-axis-bank-credit-card#006.summary: The preferred-merchant list is not published (research note), so preferred_merchants_cashback_4 stays info (H2). Cite an issuer list naming Swiggy (then override merchant Swiggy, except Instamart/Genie) or mark the example engine_checkable false.

hdfc-millennia#009.summary: EMI exclusion is emitted as category emi AND rail emi; an EMI purchase in another category (ctx other + rail emi) is not excluded. Emit category-only and rail-only exclusion rows as alternatives (as D21a does for merchant/app lists).

hdfc-phonepe-uno#008.summary: Same EMI pattern as hdfc-millennia#009 (excluded_emi: category emi AND rail emi).

phonepe-hdfc-bank-ultimo#008.summary: Same EMI pattern as hdfc-millennia#009 (exclude_emi: category emi AND rail emi).

swiggy-hdfc-bank-credit-card#009.summary: Same EMI pattern as hdfc-millennia#009 (emi_exclusion: category emi AND rail emi; card-level excluded category emi needs ctx category emi).

sbi-simplyclick#003.summary: 10X on Cleartrip excludes affiliate-channel bookings (T&C 11.1(i)), a transaction attribute the context cannot carry, so D14b keeps exclusive_partner_10x info. Per D14a the example should be engine_checkable false, unless the lead rules that a direct booking may be assumed.

sbi-simplyclick#004.summary: T&C 11.1(h): 5X capped at 10,000 RP a month, then 1 RP per Rs100. A total_points cap pays 0 after the cap. Exact model: eligible_spend Rs2,00,000 with base_rate (override), with the examples' cap deltas restated in rupees.

swiggy-hdfc-bank-credit-card#004.summary: T&C 2.3: 5% online applies only to select merchants mapped under the Table 1.2 MCCs; the merchant list is not published, so an MCC-only rule would widen (H2) and online_5pct stays info. Needs the merchant list, or engine_checkable false.

tata-neu-infinity-hdfc-bank#004.summary: Partner-brand 5% is written as brand_type/emi clauses (info). Needs an override restating it on the tata group token (tata_neu_partner) plus an EMI carve-out row (rail emi at the base rate, lower priority number), because non_emi only maps to the emi category.

tata-neu-plus-hdfc-bank#004.summary: Same as tata-neu-infinity-hdfc-bank#004 (partner_tata_brand_non_emi uses partner_tata_brand/emi/upi flags).

tata-neu-infinity-sbi-credit-card#002.summary: tata-neu-partner-5pct is info (free-text channel). Removing the channel alone would pay 5% on EMI-rail partner spends (non_emi maps only to the emi category), so it needs the same EMI carve-out as tata-neu-infinity-hdfc-bank#004.
